timeoutScope: Whole fixture worker: Vite setup, generation, both directions and repeats, all checks, and cleanup.
elapsedScope: elapsedMs and repeatMs each measure only one optimizePaths call.
heapScope: Worker heap snapshots immediately before and after first call; not peak memory, no forced GC.
memoryLimitScope: 768 MiB worker V8 old generation; not a total process RSS limit.
qualification: Software geometry invariants only. Elapsed time, heap and travel are observations, not machine runtime or quality proof.

limitScope: Whole fixture worker, including setup, both directions and verification.
